summary: Exhaustive non-option delay=0 search, 19 batches (~112 candidates). Best non-option D0 signals by the CLAUDE.md authoritative survivor threshold (WQ_IS_Sharpe>1.25 AND WQ_IS_Turnover<0.25) are short-interest factors; however NONE pass the WQ platform's full 8-check bar, which for delay=0 requires LOW_SHARPE (Sharpe ~>=2.0) AND CONCENTRATED_WEIGHT (a breadth check that news_short_interest cannot satisfy due to sparse coverage).

survivors_by_claudemd_threshold.name: si500_tr01
survivors_by_claudemd_threshold.note: Highest non-option D0 Sharpe with TO<0.25. Meets CLAUDE.md survivor threshold (SH>1.25, TO<0.25). Fails platform CONCENTRATED_WEIGHT (news_short_interest sparse coverage -> low breadth) and LOW_SHARPE (delay-0 bar ~2.0).

best_fully_concentration_passing.name: value_ebitda
best_fully_concentration_passing.note: Strongest non-option D0 signal that PASSES CONCENTRATED_WEIGHT (dense). Below the platform LOW_SHARPE ~2.0 bar. This is the realistic ceiling for an all-checks-clean non-option D0 single factor.

structural_conclusion.lowsharpe_bar_d0: ~2.0 (empirical: SH 1.60 FAILs LOW_SHARPE, option g2r SH 2.49 PASSes)
structural_conclusion.strong_signals_blocked: short interest |SH| up to 1.60 but CONCENTRATED_WEIGHT (breadth) unfixable: rank, group_zscore, group_backfill, winsorize, truncation down to 0.005, universe TOP200/500/1000, and dense-blend all fail. NaN-fill operators (coalesce, replace, nan_mask, to_nan) ALL gated at this account tier, so densification is impossible.
structural_conclusion.strong_short_sentiment_family: borrow fee / utilization / days-to-cover (mdl177*) are delay=1 ONLY (0 fields at delay=0).
structural_conclusion.dense_signals_weak: all dense (concentration-passing) price/volume/supply-chain/fundamental signals cap |SH|<0.7 individually (reversal 0.68, w52 0.18, overnight -0.31, supply-chain -0.3..0.38, issuance 0.67, gross profitability 0.34); multi-factor stacks cap ~1.0-1.5 and often dilute below the best single (value 1.07).
structural_conclusion.verdict: A non-option delay=0 factor passing ALL 8 WQ checks with Sharpe >= ~2.0 is infeasible with this account's available fields and operators. The only D0 signal both strong and dense enough to clear the bar is the OPTION IV call-put spread (g2r, SH 2.49) - precisely the family excluded by the non-option constraint.
